name: Abū Naṣr Ismāʿīl ibn Ḥammād al-Jawharī
summary: Lexicographer of Fārāb and Nishapur, pupil of al-Fārisī and of his uncle Abū Naṣr al-Fārābī, author of al-Ṣiḥāḥ, the dictionary arranged by the last letter of the root.
bio: Al-Jawharī took from Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī and from his maternal uncle Abū Naṣr al-Fārābī, the author of Dīwān al-adab. He wrote al-Ṣiḥāḥ on the language for Abū Manṣūr al-Bīshakī, Ibn al-Anbārī says, and it was transmitted through him.
He lived and died in Nishapur, about 400/1010. Al-Ṣiḥāḥ, arranged by the last letter of the root, became the model of the great later dictionaries.
uncertain: The year of his death is given as 393/1003, about 400/1010 or later; Ibn al-Anbārī gives none.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 418–421
Cevherî, İsmâil b. Hammâd, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
